description: I was first elected to Congress just 5 years ago. That’s why I was so shocked and disappointed when I heard what was on the racist recordings of L.A. City Councilmembers. My heart was broken, as someone who represents the same areas as two of the disgraced city councilmembers, and especially as a new dad. […]
